details: On August 19, President Donald Trump convened a White House meeting with key crypto industry executives, including leaders from Coinbase, Ripple, and Kraken, urging Congress to pass a "fair version of the Clarity Act." This legislation aims to establish a clear federal regulatory framework for digital assets, defining the oversight roles of the SEC and CFTC. Concurrently, the SEC proposed new rules for crypto fundraising, seeking to provide a clearer path for token issuance. These developments signify a concerted effort to solidify US crypto regulation.
title: US Pushes for Crypto Regulatory Clarity Amid White House Meeting

details: Bitcoin's price surged above $68,000, with U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) registering substantial net inflows, nearing $487 million over two days, indicating strong institutional demand. This rally was further bolstered by the U.S. Treasury's unexpected decision to double its cap on long-dated bond buybacks. This move is aimed at increasing market liquidity and lowering long-term yields, which typically enhances the appeal of risk assets like Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $68K Driven by ETF Inflows and US Treasury Boost

details: Ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, including renewed US-Iran aggression and security concerns affecting transit through the Strait of Hormuz, continue to drive oil prices higher (above $91-95 a barrel). This instability fuels global inflation fears, further compounded by hawkish signals from central banks regarding future interest rate policies. Governments' borrowing costs in several major economies have reached multi-decade highs as hopes for de-escalation fade.
title: Escalating Middle East Tensions and Hawkish Central Banks Fuel Inflation Concerns
